notes: Ludum Dare 38 horror jam game by Banana4Life (contributors Faithcaio, pschichtel, JonasDann). Complete Unity 2017.1 project with playable Intro, Main, and End scenes in EditorBuildSettings, first-person exploration scripts (PlayerController, PanicController, FlashlightController, keys/doors/teddy). GPL-3.0 at repo-root LICENSE. Third-party: UniRx (MIT, Yoshifumi Kawai) and Unity NavMeshComponents (MIT). No bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no LFS, no DLL. Omitted auto-generated JetBrains Rider editor postprocessor under Assets/Plugins/Editor/JetBrains/. Voxel sources retained under Raw/Voxel/. ~28M src snapshot.
